title: Speed, time and distance: practice set
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: Convert 72 km/h into metres per second.
A car travels 60 km at 40 km/h and then returns the same 60 km at 60 km/h. Both speeds are constant. What is its average speed for the whole round trip?
A train 150 m long passes a pole in exactly 10 seconds at a constant speed. What is its speed in km/h?
Two cyclists start together from the same point and ride in opposite directions along a straight road at constant speeds of 14 km/h and 16 km/h. After how many hours will they be 90 km apart?
A boat goes 12 km/h in still water and the stream flows at 3 km/h. It travels 45 km downstream and then returns the same 45 km upstream. How many hours does the whole trip take?

Two trains, 200 m and 300 m long, run on parallel tracks in opposite directions at constant speeds of 54 km/h and 36 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely, from the moment their fronts meet to the moment their rears clear?
In a 1000 m race run at constant speeds, A beats B by 100 m and beats C by 190 m. If B and C ran a 1000 m race against each other, by how many metres would B beat C?
A rower covers 12 km upstream in 3 hours and the same 12 km downstream in 2 hours. His rowing speed and the stream speed are constant. What is the speed of the stream in km/h?
Stations P and Q are 400 km apart. A train leaves P for Q at 60 km/h. Two hours later, another train leaves Q for P at 40 km/h. Both speeds are constant. How far from P, in km, do the trains meet?

Train X is 180 m long and runs at 72 km/h. Train Y is 120 m long and runs at 36 km/h on a parallel track in the same direction. Both speeds are constant. How many seconds does X take to overtake Y completely, from its front reaching Y's rear to its rear clearing Y's front?
